trigger.stage: Acquire frozen Football-Data lower-tier sources through immutable transport mirror
trigger.failure: FRA_Ligue1 2023/24 Football-Data F2 snapshot contains 379 completed result rows for 20 teams while a naive complete-double-round-robin check expected 380

adjudication_rule: Do not synthesize a full-time score for a fixture that did not reach a normal competitive full-time result and was resolved administratively. Such a fixture may be recorded as a documented nonstandard omission from the scored-result corpus only when an authoritative competition source identifies the exact fixture and administrative disposition. The expected scored-row count is n*(n-1) minus the count of frozen documented nonstandard omissions; every listed omission must be absent as a scored row and all remaining directed home-away pairs must be unique.

authoritative_evidence.finding: For the Ligue 2 round-36 ESTAC Troyes vs Valenciennes FC fixture of 3 May 2024, the LFP disciplinary commission ordered loss of the match by penalty against ESTAC Troyes after investigation. The evidence does not define an ordinary played full-time score to insert into the result corpus.

event_context_evidence.finding: The match was suspended at 1-1 in the 89th minute; this intermediate score is not eligible to be treated as a 90-minute full-time result.

selection_basis: authoritative competition adjudication and source-row semantics only; no candidate probability, loss, accuracy, gate result, or downstream model metric was observed or used
prohibited_actions: invent 0-3 or any other administrative score unless the authoritative source explicitly defines that score as the competition result used by the source contract
treat the 89th-minute 1-1 score as full time
drop ordinary completed fixtures to satisfy a row-count gate
add team aliases or fuzzy identity rules
change candidate parameters or scientific thresholds
